action_summary: Six passes of capability audit plus a no-model propagation loop. The audit's job was to answer one question -- what are our most advanced capabilities and who wins each -- with measured evidence rather than branch self-claims. It produced 14 documents and corrected itself five times. The zipper is the engineering half: a propagation loop driven only by error text and a static definition lookup, which cleared four rows on the 45-commit corpus byte-identically and repaired a real 9-hop rename.

expected_parent_change: canonical/verification/ gains 14 audit documents; canonical/tools/ gains 15 measured tools; canonical/tests/ gains 2 pinned tests; canonical/tools/identify_a_real_bugs_fix_v1.py gains a provenance guard that proves the suite imports the worktree rather than an installed copy.
expected_parent_frontier_change: The capability inventory stops being a set of branch self-claims and becomes a measured census: 2,238 runtime modules tiered into 1,190 production-imported, 836 test-only and 212 orphan; 19 capability families each routed to a named executor; 595 public-runner verifications each checked for credit. The frontier verdict is then stated per capability with the losing margin in the same row.
explicit_user_authorization: Owner instruction this session, verbatim and repeated four times: 'You sure those are all the advanced capabilities...? You sure, 100%?' followed by 'merge all of your work.' The repetition is the authorization: the earlier answers had sampled, and the owner required a measured census plus landing it in main.
falsification_condition: FALSIFIED if any cited capability number rests on a branch self-claim rather than a receipt, if any capability marked OWNED routes through a model or external service, or if a fabricated receipt is cited. Three fabricated receipts were found and are named in the documents: AST_IR_ANTI_UNIFICATION_ABLATION (45/45), the 84.6% figure, and the 244-commits claim.
measured_effect: Verified on the committed tree: 3.9% SWE-bench Verified vs 76.8% frontier; 2/89 blind real commits vs 0 baseline; 6/11 Terminal-Bench self-selected vs 82.7%; 0/10 global ASTRA predicates vs 51/51 non-global; 0 of 595 public-runner verifications carry capability credit; 15 of 19 families route through an external model. Four corpus rows cleared byte-identically (httpx e63b6594f2, more-itertools 71e070b35d, werkzeug d0f040a65b, packaging e7ce051e91). The zipper repaired 41597adffa in 9 monotone hops.
stop_condition: STOP when every capability family has a named executor and a frontier verdict with its margin, when every branch in the union of refs has been read rather than sampled, and when the answer to 'are these all of them' is a measured count with its residual tier stated instead of an assertion. Achieved: the residual is 836 test-only plus 212 orphan modules, named and counted, and 100% is reported as structurally unavailable.
